claim_scope: For each integer 0 <= n <= 18, the Chen-Dong Delannoy lattice is normal: all normalized matching inequalities between adjacent rank layers hold for every subset.
integrity: Exact 64-bit full-domain flow checks through n=18 and independent Python replay through n=13; no external certification or independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite exhaustive maximum-flow certificate; no assertion for n >= 19 and no symbolic all-size theorem. Closest 2026 paper proves n <= 5; earlier fixed-endpoint lattice full text not comprehensively inspected. Historical priority provisional.
title: Exact normalized matching for Delannoy lattices through size eighteen
